title: THE ENTRANCE HAS MOVED
scope_and_limits: An archive mapping gesture introduces five newly authored fictional maps and a drawn repaired handle. Delivery sketch and public sign support an address; maintenance closes the gate. A new left bell/visible pulse prompts revision and backtrack. Shortcut map adds a plan-omitted fence gap and seven drawn steps, with a three-second route pause. Remembered entrance deliberately blank; final working surface reframes the journey. V02 replaces a misleading co-location phrase with stairs instead of the old gate; route geometry remains unchanged. No historical district, survey, real child map, performed delivery, physical repair, environmental recording or historical narrator testimony is claimed. Map coordinates are authored diagram space, not metres.
reference_lineage: Peter Greenaway, A Walk Through H: The Reincarnation of an Ornithologist (1978), a journey through fictional maps, documented by its commissioner BFI.
